messages:
sam: Heads-up: Hosted streaming + tool-calls with regional edge fallback goes GA next week. :tada:
sam: New projects enabled by default; existing projects get a 14-day opt-out via Console.
sam: Edge fallback routes to compact quantized replicas in-region when heavy replicas are constrained to keep latency SLOs.
sam: Rollout: canary 2026-04-06T04:00Z (~10% us-west-2), staged ramp, GA complete by 2026-04-20.
sam: Docs & migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/streaming-fallbacks-migration
sam: Quick checklist: product -> Console toggle copy (cc @maria); SDKs -> add `edge_fallback` param; obs -> emit `hosted.fallback.count` & tag traces; support -> update KB.
maria: Console copy PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/deploy/pull/820 3 I added the opt-out modal text.
devon: Obs plan: tag requests with `fallback=true` + per-minute gauge. I'll add a 5xx counter for fallback failures.
kevin: We'll show a deprecation banner for legacy v1 streaming at canary start; CS email wave coordinated with growth.
emily: Nice work team! This should reduce P99s for interactive apps. :rocket:
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-rollout/streaming-edge-fallbacks/us-west-2 @ 2026-04-06T04:00:00Z
support-bot: KB stub created: `support/hosted_streaming_edge_fallbacks.md` 3 please fill with opt-out steps and FAQs.
